entries.name: ContainerManagerCommon
entries.note: Per-app container folders (Documents, Library, Library/Caches, tmp) with backup and purge classes and refusal of symbolic links exist. The reference container class database (the Container.Class and Containers property lists and the daemon and system policies) is not modelled.

entries.name: ContainerManagerSystem
entries.note: systemd, listed in the runtime package list, creates and owns each daemon's state and cache directories through StateDirectory= and CacheDirectory=. The reference system container classes (systemData, systemGroup, protectedSystem) and their entitlements are not modelled.

entries.name: ContainerManagerUser
entries.note: The per-user app container folders are laid out, backed up and purged by class. The reference per-user container classes (perUserApp, pluginData) and the container property list database are not modelled.

entries.name: ContentKit
entries.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/content_sniff.rs (sniff; maps signatures to UTType identifiers)
entries.note: A bounded pure sniffer recognizes common signatures and maps them to the identifiers in uttype.rs, with host integration tests. The ContentKit API was not confirmed from magic.mgc; this is not a magic-database-compatible engine, and no picker or preview consumer calls it yet.

entries.name: ContextKit
entries.note: Its XPC service (bundle com.apple.siri.context.service) feeds the vendor's Siri context model, which has no meaning without that assistant.

entries.name: ContextKitCore
entries.note: Core of the same Siri context model (bundle com.apple.contextkit.ContextKitCore); only its property list was extracted, and the model serves the vendor's assistant only.

entries.name: ContextKitExtraction
entries.note: Extracts page content for the vendor's assistant context model (its one script resource, DOMNodeInformationExtractor.js, reads page DOM nodes), and that pipeline serves only the vendor's assistant.

entries.name: ContextSync
entries.note: Syncs the vendor's Biome context streams (bundle com.apple.biome.ContextSync) between the owner's own devices through the vendor's account services.

entries.name: ContextualSuggestionClient
entries.note: Client for the vendor's proactive suggestion service (bundle com.apple.proactive.ContextualSuggestionClient); the suggestions come from the vendor's on-device assistant, so there is nothing to mirror.

entries.name: ContextualUnderstanding
entries.note: On-device understanding behind the vendor's proactive suggestions (bundle com.apple.proactive.ContextualUnderstanding); only its property list was extracted, and it serves the vendor's assistant only.

entries.name: ContinuousDialogManagerService
entries.note: assistant_cdmd is the Siri continuous dialogue daemon (bundle com.apple.siri.cdm), linked against the Siri natural language frameworks; it serves the vendor's assistant only.

entries.name: ControlCenter
entries.note: The shell's Control Center draws the swipe-down cluster of module tiles, including Wi-Fi and now-playing controls, over a frosted copy of the screen. The reference's user-editable module list and per-module settings are not mirrored.

entries.name: ConversationKit
entries.note: FaceTime and telephone call UI (call-recording countdown, in-call and video-call assets; its AppKit bundle is com.apple.facetime), which runs on the vendor's calling service.

entries.name: ConversationalInteraction
entries.note: The vendor's Siri conversation interface (bundle com.apple.ConversationalInteraction); only its property list was extracted, and it has no meaning without that assistant.

entries.name: CookingData
entries.note: Only the property list (bundle com.apple.CookingData) was in the reference extract, with no binary or resource, so the data it holds and its purpose are not determined.

entries.name: Coordination
entries.note: Only the property list (bundle com.apple.Coordination) was in the reference extract, with no binary or resource, so the purpose is not determined.

entries.name: CoordinationCore
entries.note: Only the property list (bundle com.apple.CoordinationCore) was in the reference extract, with no binary or resource, so the purpose is not determined.

entries.name: CopresenceCore
entries.note: Proximity sharing between the owner's own vendor devices (the extract holds only its alert icon and string table), so BifrOSt has no device pair to mirror it with.

entries.name: CoreADI
entries.note: adid is the Apple Device Identity daemon that provisions the device for the vendor's account and certificate services; its certificate checks name apple.com authorities, so it serves only the vendor's cloud.

entries.name: CoreALD
entries.note: The reference extract holds no property list, binary or resource for this framework (only its name is listed), so the purpose is not determined.

entries.name: CoreAUC
entries.note: Only the property list (bundle com.apple.CoreAUC, version 638.12) was in the reference extract, with no binary or resource, so the purpose is not determined.

entries.name: CoreAVCHD
entries.note: ffmpeg, listed in the runtime package list, demuxes AVCHD MPEG-TS streams and decodes their H.264 video. Not verified on Midget, and the framework's camcorder import features are not mirrored.

entries.name: CoreAccessibility
entries.note: Accessibility settings (zoom, reduce motion, contrast, transparency, touch accommodations) and the AT-SPI bridge that exports app trees to screen readers exist. Coverage of the reference's full accessibility runtime is not verified.

entries.name: CoreAccessories
entries.note: Attach and detach events, matching listeners and one-owner opening of USB accessories exist. The reference accessory daemon's host attestation and certified-accessory authentication are not mirrored.

entries.name: CoreAnalytics
entries.note: analyticsd uploads usage and health metrics to the vendor's report configuration servers (core-reporting-configs.cdn-apple.com), keyed by a device identifier. BifrOSt has no vendor telemetry to mirror.

entries.name: CoreAnalyticsSwiftBridge
entries.note: Swift bridge to the same vendor telemetry pipeline as CoreAnalytics (only its property list was extracted), so it has no BifrOSt meaning.

entries.name: CoreAppleCVA
entries.note: Only the property lists (bundle com.apple.CoreAppleCVA, version 4.4.1) were in the reference extract, with no binary or resource, so the purpose is not determined.

entries.name: CoreAudioOrchestration
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreAudio; from SDK matrix core-audio.json

entries.name: CoreAutoLayout
entries.note: The constraint solver with required and weighted priorities, the engine behind the layout constraint API, exists. The reference's layout anchors and visual format language are not verified.

entries.name: CoreBluetoothUI
entries.note: The app-facing Bluetooth device picker exists as a pure model in which the user chooses a device. The picker never pairs a device, and the shell's pairing sheet is not reviewed here.

entries.name: CoreBrightness
entries.note: Night Shift tints the final frame, and the Display & Brightness settings pane holds the brightness setting. The reference's ambient and True Tone sensing is not mirrored.

entries.name: CoreCDP
entries.note: cdpd runs the vendor's cloud keychain circle, with keychain-cloud-circle and restore-keychain entitlements, so it only serves the vendor's cloud sync.

entries.name: CoreCDPInternal
entries.note: Internal half of the same cloud data protection stack that cdpd runs for the vendor's cloud keychain (only its property list was extracted).

entries.name: CoreCDPUI
entries.note: Recovery-key and iCloud preference sheets for the vendor's cloud keychain (CDPRecoveryKeySheet and CDPiCloudPrefRecoveryKeyController resources), which sign in to the vendor's account.

entries.name: CoreCapture
entries.note: Only the property lists (bundle com.apple.CoreCapture) were in the reference extract; the capture daemon is not in the extracted tree, so the purpose is not determined.

entries.name: CoreCaptureControl
entries.note: Only the property list (bundle com.apple.CoreCaptureControl) was in the reference extract, with no binary or resource, so the purpose is not determined.

entries.name: CoreCaptureDaemon
entries.note: Undetermined: the reference index lists only the bundle and its resources, and no binary was in the extracted payload, so its job is not confirmed and no BifrOSt counterpart is identified.

entries.name: CoreChineseEngine
entries.note: The shell's fcitx5 bridge switches to the Chinese input method when fcitx5 is installed, and does nothing otherwise. No pinyin dictionary or input-code tool ships with BifrOSt, so the candidates come from fcitx5 alone.

entries.name: CoreComposite
entries.note: Undetermined: the reference index lists only the bundle's resource folder and no binary was extracted, so its job is not confirmed and no BifrOSt counterpart is identified.

entries.name: CoreDAV
entries.note: CalDAV and CardDAV principal and collection discovery, event and card reads, and periodic sync for Calendar and Contacts exist. The module docs describe reads only, so writing edits back to the server is not covered.

entries.name: CoreDeviceSelection
entries.note: Output and input device lists, per-role defaults, volume and route-change events exist, and the audio setup app shows the devices. Wireless speaker routing with a route picker is not built.

entries.name: CoreDiagnostics
entries.note: Local crash.log entries, the quit-unexpectedly alert and a report saved next to the data are in place. Nothing is uploaded to a vendor, and general usage analytics are not collected.

entries.name: CoreDuet
entries.note: On-device usage learning that feeds the reference vendor's suggestion features. It has no meaning without that vendor's suggestion service, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: CoreDuetContext
entries.note: The context store that the reference vendor's suggestion features read. It only has meaning inside that vendor's suggestion service, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: CoreDuetDaemonProtocol
entries.note: Message definitions for the usage-learning daemon. With no such daemon on this system there is no protocol to implement.

entries.name: CoreDuetSync
entries.note: Syncs the usage-learning store between the reference vendor's devices through that vendor's cloud account. BifrOSt has no such account, so the component has no meaning here.

entries.name: CoreEmbeddedSpeechRecognition
entries.note: Nothing does on-device speech-to-text. springboard/ui/src/recognition.rs and recognition_task.rs are result and task models only; no recognizer or dictation service exists in springboard/. Build a local recognition service that takes microphone audio and returns text, for dictation in the Search field and in apps.

entries.name: CoreEmoji
entries.note: The emoji catalogue, the character viewer panel and the keyboard emoji page exist, and a pick types or copies the emoji. Missing: a search field over the catalogue, recent emoji, and the search name lists.

entries.name: CoreFP
entries.note: Media licence (DRM) client that unlocks media bought from the reference vendor's store with that vendor's keys. The store and its keys do not exist on this system.

entries.name: CoreFollowUp
entries.note: Follow-up alerts for the reference vendor's accessory-finding network, shipped with its own extension bundle. It needs that network and its hardware tags, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: CoreFollowUpUI
entries.note: The interface for the accessory follow-up alerts. It only has meaning with the reference vendor's accessory-finding network, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: CoreHAP
entries.note: Pairing and control of home accessories over the reference vendor's own home accessory protocol, used only by its home ecosystem. The open standard is tracked separately in the Matter rows of the SDK matrix.

entries.name: CoreHandwriting
entries.note: Stroke grouping into text lines and their reading order are in place. Recognising the letters needs a recogniser that the shell or an app supplies, and none ships with BifrOSt.

entries.name: CoreHapticsTools
entries.note: Rate-limited pulse requests and force-feedback effects for wheels and joysticks exist. Authoring of haptic patterns is missing, and the touchpad actuator the reference system uses has no counterpart on this hardware.

entries.name: CoreIDCred
entries.note: Issues the reference vendor's digital identity credential into its identity store, through that vendor's identity service. The service and its credentials do not exist on this system.

entries.name: CoreIDCredBuilder
entries.note: Builds the credential package for the reference vendor's digital identity service. It only has meaning with that service, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: CoreIDV
entries.note: Identity verification flows, with document checks, for the reference vendor's identity service. The service does not exist on this system.

entries.name: CoreIDVDaemonSupport
entries.note: Daemon-side support for the reference vendor's identity verification flows. No such service runs on this system.

entries.name: CoreIDVRGBLiveness
entries.note: Liveness check on camera frames for the reference vendor's identity verification. It only has meaning with that service.

entries.name: CoreIDVShared
entries.note: Shared types for the reference vendor's identity verification flows. Nothing on this system needs them without that service.

entries.name: CoreIDVUI
entries.note: Interface for the reference vendor's identity verification, run in its own service process. It only has meaning with that service.

entries.name: CoreIK
entries.note: Undetermined beyond its name: an inverse kinematics solver for 3D rigs. No binary was extracted, and BifrOSt has no 3D rig or inverse kinematics (spritekit.json records none), so the lead should decide between gap and n/a.

entries.name: CoreIMS
entries.note: Carrier voice and messaging stack for cellular radios. BifrOSt has no cellular modem stack, and no modem manager is in the runtime package list.

entries.name: CoreJapaneseEngine
entries.note: Kana input runs through fcitx5 with its Japanese engine when fcitx5 is installed. The shell's Search field composes kana itself. No Japanese dictionary ships with BifrOSt.

entries.name: CoreKDL
entries.note: Undetermined: the kernel extension bundle has no contents in the reference index and no binary was extracted, so its job is not confirmed and no BifrOSt counterpart is identified.

entries.name: CoreKE
entries.note: Key store service whose keybags are bound to the reference vendor's own hardware security module, with its own key-store daemon. BifrOSt's app keychain access is handled by the shell's keychain groups service, not by this hardware.

entries.name: CoreKnowledge
entries.note: Undetermined: only the bundle's resource folder is in the reference index and no binary was extracted, so its job is not confirmed and no BifrOSt counterpart is identified.

entries.name: CoreLSKD
entries.note: Key delivery daemon for the reference vendor's licensed media, tied to its key service and hardware keys. It has no meaning on this system.

entries.name: CoreMaterial
entries.note: The layer material model exists, including the glass material with blur, tint and saturation. The reference system's named material recipes for system surfaces are not reproduced.

entries.name: CoreMaterial3D
entries.note: Undetermined beyond its name: a 3D material system with only resource folders in the reference index and no binary extracted. BifrOSt has no 3D material surface, so the lead should decide between gap and n/a.

entries.name: CoreMediaStream
entries.note: File demux and playback in springboard/src/media exist. No HTTP live streaming segment support was found, so streamed network media is not covered.

entries.name: CoreMediaSwiftUpwardLinkingTrampoline
entries.note: A linking shim that lets Swift code call the reference vendor's media framework. It is a compiler and linker detail with no use in a Rust stack.

entries.name: CoreMotionAlgorithms
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreMotion; from SDK matrix core-motion.json

entries.name: CoreMotionFDNML
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreMotion; from SDK matrix core-motion.json

entries.name: CoreNLP
entries.note: The reference's natural language runtime with quantized per-script language models is counterpart to the NaturalLanguage row. BifrOSt covers only word tokenizing and pattern-based data detection; no language models, tagger or embeddings exist.

entries.name: CoreNameParser
entries.note: Partial: the contacts store splits a full name at its last word into given and family name (split_name in services/contacts.rs). Not built: middle and suffix parts, and the bundled frequency and surname tables.

entries.name: CoreNavigation
entries.note: Turn-by-turn guidance driven by a GNSS range-error model calibrated for the reference's own location chips (H12 to H16 bundles). BifrOSt has no GNSS receiver or location source, so the component has no input.

entries.name: CoreOC
entries.note: Only Info.plist and version data are in the reference image, and the binary sits in the dyld cache, which was not extracted. The purpose is not confirmed, so the row stays os until the library is inspected.

entries.name: CoreOCModules
entries.note: Holds one default Metal library plus Info.plist and version data; the modules' role is not confirmed from the binary, which was not extracted.

entries.name: CoreOptimization
entries.note: Only Info.plist is in the reference image, so the optimization job is not confirmed. Power and resource tuning on BifrOSt is handled by the system layer, not by an SDK surface.

entries.name: CorePDF
entries.note: Backs the PDFKit row. The Books reader parses PDF pages, text, images and outlines, and the SDK prints through the print module. No app-facing PDF document, annotation, form or selection API exists, and the reference's font-info tables are not used.

entries.name: CoreParsec
entries.note: Daemon for Spotlight, Messages, Look Up and Safari suggestions; its usage text says it sends the device location to get local results, which means the reference's own search services. BifrOSt has no such service and no location source.

entries.name: CorePhoneNumbers
entries.note: Backs the Data Detection row. Phone numbers in text are found by pattern detection. The reference's per-region ruleset for parsing, validation and formatting is not implemented.

entries.name: CorePhotogrammetry
entries.note: Photogrammetry reconstruction (feature matching, multi-view stereo, meshing, texturing and Gaussian splatting Metal kernels) for the reference's object capture. BifrOSt has no 3D scene layer, and its RealityKit row is n/a.

entries.name: CorePrediction
entries.note: Only Info.plist is in the reference image. The name suggests predictive text, which BifrOSt's keyboard predictor (springboard/apps/keyboard/src/predict.rs) only partly covers, but the framework's role is not confirmed.

entries.name: CoreRC
entries.note: Remote-control plugins for the reference's living-room hardware: a HID service for its handheld remote and an HDMI-CEC interface listener for TV control. BifrOSt has no such remote hardware or CEC path.

entries.name: CoreRE
entries.note: Reality rendering engine for the reference's RealityKit: AR render graphs, Metal binary archives and material resources. BifrOSt is a 2D desktop with no 3D scene layer, and its RealityKit row is n/a.

entries.name: CoreRE3DGSFoundation
entries.note: Gaussian splatting foundation with one Metal library, used by the reference's 3D capture and RealityKit scenes. BifrOSt has no 3D scene layer.

entries.name: CoreRealityIO
entries.note: Loads Reality and USD scenes for the reference's RealityKit, with MaterialX shading libraries for the surfaces. BifrOSt has no 3D scene or asset layer, and its RealityKit row is n/a.

entries.name: CoreRecents
entries.note: A local store of recent people and addresses (a recents table with contacts and metadata, used as recipients for Mail and Messages). Build a recents store for recipients that the mail and messages apps feed; BifrOSt's recent items list covers only apps and documents (springboard/src/shell/recent_items.rs).

entries.name: CoreRecognition
entries.note: A Core ML character recognition model (a Chinese character convolutional network) for text and handwriting recognition. Build an on-device text recognizer for images and screenshots; BifrOSt reads only QR codes (springboard/src/shell/camera/qr.rs).

entries.name: CoreRepairCore
entries.note: Launch daemon and XPC services for the reference's hardware diagnostics and repair preflight (Mach services for diagnostics, preflight and intent control). The service only works with the reference's own hardware.

entries.name: CoreRepairKit
entries.note: Shared strings and Info.plist for the reference's hardware repair flow. It has no code path that applies to BifrOSt's hardware.

entries.name: CoreRepairUI
entries.note: User interface for the reference's hardware repair flow: an app icon, a compiled asset catalog and strings. The flow only applies to the reference's own hardware.

entries.name: CoreReporting
entries.note: Only Info.plist and version data are in the reference image, so the reporting role is not confirmed from the binary, which was not extracted. Crash and diagnostics upload is the likely job and would be n/a, but this is not verified.

entries.name: CoreRoutine
entries.note: On-device place learning for the reference's location history: visit trajectory and place-type classifiers, a diagnostics extension and a Core Data store of routines. BifrOSt has no location source, so the component has no input.

entries.name: CoreRoutineDiagnostics
entries.note: Diagnostics for the place-learning service (the reference's diagnostics extension of CoreRoutine). BifrOSt does not run that service because it has no location source.

entries.name: CoreRoutineProtobuf
entries.note: Protocol buffer message definitions for the reference's place-learning service, which BifrOSt does not run. BifrOSt's own wire types live in springboard/proto.

entries.name: CoreSDB
entries.note: Only Info.plist, localized strings and version data are in the reference image. The purpose is not determined, because the binary sits in the dyld cache and was not extracted.

entries.name: CoreSVG
entries.note: SVG parsing and rasterizing for images and icons. Build an SVG reader in the render crate; BifrOSt reads only the SVG size (svg_size in springboard/src/shell/browser/resources.rs) and drops SVG from mail HTML.

entries.name: CoreSceneUnderstanding
entries.note: Image and video scene models (CLIP text and image embeddings, captioning decoders, a scene classifier and taxonomies) for content search in Photos. Build an on-device Core ML model runtime, which the Core ML row lacks, and a scene index for the Photos app.

entries.name: CoreServicesInternal
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreServices; from SDK matrix core-services.json

entries.name: CoreServicesStore
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreServices; from SDK matrix core-services.json

entries.name: CoreServicesUI
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreServices; from SDK matrix core-services.json

entries.name: CoreSpeech
entries.note: Speech recognition models and signed model blobs for dictation and the voice assistant. The recognition models in springboard/ui/src/recognition_task.rs have no recognizer behind them, and the keyboard dictation key does nothing. Build an on-device recognizer that consumes the audio service recordings (springboard/audiod/src/main.rs).

entries.name: CoreSpeechExclave
entries.note: Speech processing that runs inside the reference's hardware exclave, an isolated processing environment on its own silicon. BifrOSt has no such hardware, and only Info.plist is in the reference image.

entries.name: CoreSpeechFoundation
entries.note: Shared speech framework behind the Speech row. BifrOSt covers only microphone recording to WAV on an explicit request; there is no recognizer, and only Info.plist is in the reference image.

entries.name: CoreSpeechUtils
entries.note: Speech utilities behind the Speech row. BifrOSt covers only microphone recording to WAV on an explicit request, with no recognizer; only Info.plist is in the reference image.

entries.name: CoreSpotlightAgenticCore
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreSpotlight; from SDK matrix core-spotlight.json

entries.name: CoreSpotlightImportDaemon
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreSpotlight; from SDK matrix core-spotlight.json

entries.name: CoreSuggestions
entries.note: Backs the Core Spotlight row for suggestions. Per-app searchable items and the Search panel's Documents list exist, but the suggestion and query models are host-tested only, and on-device extraction of events, flights and time zones is missing.

entries.name: CoreSuggestionsInternals
entries.note: Data assets for suggestions: airport and time zone tables, attribute name tables, a template script and calibration plists for the suggestion models. Build the asset loader and the tables when the suggestion engine is wired to the Search panel.

entries.name: CoreSuggestionsML
entries.note: The model asset catalog for suggestion ranking holds only its code signature in the reference image, so there is no model content to port. The purpose is inferred from the name.

entries.name: CoreSuggestionsUI
entries.note: Suggestion views for the reference's Mail, Messages and Search: a suggested-event popover, a paging popover and a found-in suggestion view. Build these popovers on the SDK's popover and list kits once the suggestion engine is wired.

entries.name: CoreSuggestionsUIMacHelper
entries.note: Helper bundle for the suggestion views, with only Info.plist and version data in the reference image. Its exact role is not confirmed.

entries.name: CoreSymbolication
entries.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/crash_report.rs (symbolicate_address); gdb and systemd (coredumpctl) from packaging/arch/runtime-packages.txt
entries.note: Addresses are symbolicated from the image list an app supplies, with inline frames expanded, and core dumps are kept by systemd. Gap: no system-wide symbolication service turns crash logs into named frames, and live processes are not symbolicated.

entries.name: CoreThemeDefinition
entries.bifrost: springboard/src/appearance_portal.rs (light or dark scheme and accent); springboard/ui/src/bar_appearance.rs (inherited appearance objects)
entries.note: The effective scheme and accent reach apps through the appearance file, and bar appearance objects inherit from a standard appearance. Gap: there is no editable theme definition format, so theme values exist only in code.

entries.name: CoreThread
entries.note: The Thread mesh network stack for home accessories paired through the vendor's home app; BifrOSt has no Thread network, and springboard/core/src/matter.rs only parses Matter setup codes.

entries.name: CoreThreadCommissionerService
entries.note: The operational dataset a commissioner gives an accessory is parsed, checked and reported for missing fields. Gap: nothing commissions a device, runs a border router or drives a radio.

entries.name: CoreThreadRadio
entries.note: Driver service for the vendor's own Thread radio chip, with per-chip calibration mapping files; BifrOSt runs on hardware without that radio.

entries.name: CoreTime
entries.bifrost: springboard/src/net/ntp.rs (SNTP client); springboard/src/bare/timezone.rs (zone rules from the tz database)
entries.note: The clock is corrected over SNTP once the network has an address, and zone offsets and daylight saving come from the system tz database. Gap: the reference's time-source plug-ins (a paired-device clock and a virtual-machine clock) have no counterpart.

entries.name: CoreTransparency
entries.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (the URL client's TLS stack, where the check belongs)
entries.note: No Certificate Transparency check runs on TLS connections, so a certificate that no log records is accepted. Build an embedded log list and signed-timestamp verification into the URL client's rustls stack; the framework binary is not in the extract, so this rests on its name.

entries.name: CoreUARP
entries.note: Accessory firmware update platform for the vendor's own Bluetooth and USB accessories; BifrOSt has no such accessories to update.

entries.name: CoreUI
entries.note: Named images resolve to the variant for the screen scale, as a catalog lookup does. Gap: compiled asset catalogs are not read, and there is no theme rendering beyond the design kit.

entries.name: CoreUSDEdit
entries.note: The OpenUSD library reads and writes scene files. Gap: the editing layer, the Metal renderer and the MaterialX shaders of the reference are not mirrored, and no USD editor exists.

entries.name: CoreUtils
entries.note: Internal utility framework (version 900.58) with a localization table; the extract holds no binary, so its symbols and job could not be read and it stays os.

entries.name: CoreUtilsExtras
entries.note: Internal utility framework with only its Info.plist in the extract; its job is not known and no owner rule matches, so it stays os.

entries.name: CoreUtilsShims
entries.note: Internal utility framework with only its Info.plist in the extract; its job is not known and no owner rule matches, so it stays os.

entries.name: CoreUtilsSwift
entries.note: Internal utility framework with only its Info.plist in the extract; its job is not known and no owner rule matches, so it stays os.

entries.name: CoreUtilsUI
entries.note: Internal UI utility framework with a localization table; the binary is not in the extract, so its job is not known and it stays os.

entries.name: CoreWLANKit
entries.note: Interface state, scan results with channel and security, saved profiles and join or forget reach the shell through the wpa_supplicant control socket and apps through typed values. Gap: no app call joins or selects a network, and access-point modes are missing.

entries.name: CoreWiFi
entries.note: The Wi-Fi service's interface discovery, scanning, joining and link status are covered by the modules that CoreWLANKit uses. Gap: the service's roaming and diagnostic logic have no counterpart.

entries.name: Cosmo
entries.note: Framework with an Info.plist and no other file in the extract; its job is not known and no owner rule matches, so it stays os.

entries.name: CrashReporterSupport
entries.note: Support for sending diagnostic reports to the vendor's collection service (its resources carry SubmitDiagInfo configuration); BifrOSt sends nothing to a vendor service, and local crash capture is covered under CoreSymbolication.

entries.name: CrisisResources
entries.note: Per-country helpline lists for mental health, suicide prevention, domestic violence, sexual assault, poison control and general emergencies, shown by the vendor's own safety features; BifrOSt has no such feature and no such content.

entries.name: CryptexKit
entries.note: Client for the vendor's Cryptex images, signed sub-volumes the vendor patches on the sealed system volume; BifrOSt updates through pacman packages (packaging/arch/PKGBUILD) and has no sealed volume to patch.

entries.name: CryptexServer
entries.note: Server side of the vendor's Cryptex images, which mounts signed sub-volumes for rapid fixes; BifrOSt updates through pacman packages (packaging/arch/PKGBUILD) and has no sealed volume to patch.

entries.name: CryptoKitCBridging
entries.note: The primitives the bridge exposes to the crypto kit (SHA-2, AES-GCM, X25519, Ed25519) are pure Rust and tested headless. Gap: apps cannot call them yet.

entries.name: CryptoKitPrivate
entries.note: The private layer's primitives are covered by the same pure Rust modules. Gap: there is no hardware-backed key path and no app entry point.

entries.name: acfs
entries.note: Client for the shared SAN file system, with migration and backup scripts for SAN volumes; BifrOSt machines mount no SAN volume.

entries.name: acfsSupport
entries.note: Kernel extension that mounts the SAN file system for the shared file system client; BifrOSt mounts only its btrfs layout (springboard/src/installer/plan.rs, BTRFS_LAYOUT).

entries.name: apfs_boot_mount
entries.note: Mounts the APFS system volume at boot; BifrOSt roots on btrfs with the subvolume layout in springboard/src/installer/plan.rs, so no APFS volume is mounted.

entries.name: asmp
entries.note: Framework (version 1.5.1) with an Info.plist and icon only in the extract; its job is not known and no owner rule matches, so it stays os.

entries.name: caulk
entries.note: Audio framework by bundle name; packaging/arch/bifrost-audiod.service is the nearest counterpart, but the framework's job is not confirmed without its binary, so it stays os.
